{{Quote|For the ultimate dessert, sample this deluxe, Cloud City-style dessert prepared with three massive scoops of Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream--denta bean, Trammistan chocolate and beebleberry--and garnished with flavorful toppings, atomically aerated cream, crushed ettel nuts and real Ecclessis figs.|The figs are mentioned in the description of a Tibanna split|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Ecclessis figs''' were a type of edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] used as a dessert garnish. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the figs as one of the toppings on their [[Tibanna split]] [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] dish, along with [[atomically aerated cream]] and crushed [[ettel nut]]s. The dish itself was made in a style based on that of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and consisted of three flavors of [[Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream|Hood family "Bespinian best" ice cream]]&mdash;[[Denta bean ice cream|Denta bean]], [[Trammistan chocolate ice cream|Trammistan chocolate]] and [[Beebleberry ice cream/Legends|beebleberry]]. It was considered delicious by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of Dex's, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who served it for 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="DaD" /> until his diner's destruction during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule.<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' established that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later stated that the novel took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], so Dex's Diner was destroyed either during 19 BBY or 18 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ecclessis figs were first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] and released in [[2009]] on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="DaD" /> Their name is a reference to [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], the founder of Cloud City.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
